title: 147. Pow(x, n)
hints: This is a portable adaptation: parse the input string as a double and return a finite, double-parseable decimal string.
Use exponentiation by squaring, halving the exponent at each step.
Store the exponent in a wider signed integer before negating it so the minimum 32-bit exponent is handled safely.
For a negative exponent, invert the base and use the positive magnitude of the exponent.
